question.problem:
An initial value problem has the exact solution ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)=\operatorname{cos}⁡x.$ A numerical method is used to approximate the solution to the initial value problem, resulting in the table below, where $y$ denotes the approximate solution at each step, and ${τ}_{n}$ is the local truncation error at each step. At each step, the exact value is used to approximate the new value. 

Calculate the local truncation error at each step. Round your answers to three decimal places.

| $n$ | $x$ | $y$ | ${τ}_{n}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $1.000$ | $0$ |
| $1$ | $0.25$ | $0.970$ | {{field-1}} |
| $2$ | $0.5$ | $0.880$ | {{field-2}} |
| $3$ | $0.75$ | $0.735$ | {{field-3}} |
question.worked_solution:
The local truncation error (LTE) is the error made in a *single step* of a numerical method, when the step begins from an *exact value*. The LTE of a numerical method at step $n$ from $x$ with exact value ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-({y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+Δy).\end{aligned}
$$

We find the LTE at each step, rounding to three decimal places in each case:

- After the first step, we have ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.970.$ So, the LTE of the first step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{1} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.25)-0.970 \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(0.25)-0.970 \\  & ≈-0.001.\end{aligned}
$$

- After the second step, we have ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.880.$ So, the LTE of the second step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{2} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.5)-0.880 \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(0.5)-0.880 \\  & ≈-0.002.\end{aligned}
$$

- After the third step, we have ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.735.$ So, the LTE of the third step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{3} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.75)-0.735 \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(0.75)-0.735 \\  & ≈-0.003.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the completed table is as given below.

| $n$ | $x$ | $y$ | ${τ}_{n}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $1.000$ | $0$ |
| $1$ | $0.25$ | $0.970$ | $-0.001$ |
| $2$ | $0.5$ | $0.880$ | $-0.002$ |
| $3$ | $0.75$ | $0.735$ | $-0.003$ |
